equation.Y: Y(p, a) = W(p, a) / B(p, a)
equation.G: G(p) = Y(p, omni) / Y(p, native) − 1 = (1 + w(p)) / (1 + b(p)) − 1 ≈ w(p) − b(p)
equation.total: G(total) = Σₚ S(p)(1 + w(p)) / Σₚ S(p)(1 + b(p)) − 1, S(p) the owner's native spend in place p
equation.bill: B = Σₖ cₖ, b = Σₖ sₖ·bₖ, sₖ = cₖ(native) / B(native)
